record.question: He read a number of books and magazines __________ he was ill.
record.explanation: Answer B: while. “While he was ill” is a time clause; the blank takes “while”. Independent check: “While he was ill” refers to the period during which he read; “while” introduces a time clause. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/while.
